claim: The original matching retail SkillInfo DLC flag methods are pinned by complete original IL, metadata and direct callers: CheckValidationDLCMove 0x06001145 (65 bytes), GetDLC 0x06001146 (36), GetDLCList 0x06001147 (59), IsDLCMove 0x06001148 (36). All read original SkillInfo.dlc field 0x04000ED4; IsDLCMove loops over 16 slots but GetDLC/GetDLCList/CheckValidationDLCMove loop over 13. Source CheckValidationDLCMove returns true when no flag is enabled or when at least one enabled DLC index among 0..12 passes SaveData.IsDLCInstalled. Source GetDLC returns first enabled 0..12 index or -1; GetDLCList checks Contains then Add for enabled 0..12 indices. The source does not establish asset-backed flag bytes, actual installation, array shape or runtime success.
